run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with --config and --out-path to fit linear element references
run_fit_linref_function: run fit_linref with a config dict and output path to fit and save linear references
fit_linear_references: fit linear element references from a training dataset using batched linear regression
save_checkpoint_linref: save a linear reference state dict as a checkpoint file using save_checkpoint
load_config_for_fit: load a YAML config file with load_config to get settings for fitting element references
